Stockfish.js 19.0.1, unmodified release build (lite, single-threaded WebAssembly).
stockfish-19-lite-single.worker.js is stockfish-19-lite-single.js renamed so the
bundler embeds it as text.
Source and build instructions: https://github.com/nmrugg/stockfish.js/tree/v19.0.1
Release: https://github.com/nmrugg/stockfish.js/releases/tag/v19.0.1
